text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that Agnes Tachyon? She recently sparked a lot of controversy on the internet.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, that's her. I was interested, so I watched the footage of the Kikuka Sho. She performed pretty well actually.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: She surprised the crowd at the Kikuka Sho, but the question is—how will she fare today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon lets out a carefree yawn, paying no heed to the surrounding chatter.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Tsk tsk, silly guinea pig. I appear relaxed because I am focused.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I've been employing various breathing and muscle relaxation techniques to ease both my mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It is a proven type of mental training built on the foundation of sports science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Besides, today brings the first of our long-awaited goal races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I got your hopes up back then, so it only makes sense that I prove my hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As compensation for accompanying me along this journey beyond limits, I'll reward you with a few victories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, then, let's hear your plans for my senior year schedule. I'm all ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She promised me that just a few days after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She responds with a shrewd grin.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit. So you just sit back, relax, and enjoy the show!
